source(output(
		{Fee ID} as double,
		{Fee Type} as string,
		Group as string,
		{Fee Amount} as decimal(19,19),
		{Effective Start Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Updated By} as string,
		{Effective En Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> NSFFeeSetUpSource
NSFFeeSetUpSource derive({Copy of Group} = toString(Group)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		GROUPID as string,
		FEETYPE as string,
		EFFECTIVEENDDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EFFECTIVESTARTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FEEID as integer,
		UPDATEDBY as string,
		FEEAMOUNT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		GROUPID = {Copy of Group},
		FEETYPE = {Copy of Fee Type},
		EFFECTIVEENDDATE = {Copy of Effective En Date},
		EFFECTIVESTARTDATE = {Copy of Effective Start Date},
		FEEID = {Copy of Fee ID},
		UPDATEDBY = {Copy of Updated By},
		FEEAMOUNT = {Copy of Fee Amount})) ~> NSFFEESETUPDEST
